title: Prospective Cohort With Hemopathy in Languedoc-Roussillon
official: Prospective Cohort Study of Clinical and Laboratory Data of Patients With Hemopathy in Languedoc-Roussillon
summary: Prospective Cohort Study of clinical and laboratory data of patients with hemopathy.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Age over 18
* Consultant or hospitalized patient for suspected malignant hemopathy and justifying further exploration or patient with a diagnosis of malignant hemopathy less than 6 months old at the time of signing the consent
* Having signed an informed consent
* Affiliated with a social security scheme

Exclusion criteria:

* Minor or major protected
* Patients who have received treatment for hematological pathology
